## Change and evidence

Describe the user problem, the smallest change and how it was tested.

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant Chromium/schema tests pass.
- [ ] No raw account data, prompts, diagnostics exports or private screenshots committed.
- [ ] Storage/migration compatibility preserved or explicitly reviewed.
- [ ] Privacy, diagnostics schema and known limitations updated where needed.
- [ ] Live versus synthetic validation distinguished.
- [ ] No unrelated model switching, network polling or UI redesign added.
